name: Swimmer Gwen

intro.text: I swim in the bay every day of the year. It's eight degrees in January and I feel marvellous. That's the cold talking.

win: Fair play. I'm off for a hot chocolate and a lie down.
after: The tides here are some of the biggest in Europe, up to twelve metres between low and high. Sandy beaches turn into a mile of rock pools twice a day.
